# a2a skill

<!-- Generated from the command definitions; do not edit. -->

Print the a2a-cli SKILL.md bundled into this binary: instructions for teaching an agent to drive A2A agents with this CLI.

```
a2a skill
```

**Examples**

```bash
a2a skill > ~/.claude/skills/a2a-cli/SKILL.md
```

The [global flags](a2a.md#global-flags) apply too.
